title: Revenue—Barter Transactions Involving Advertising Services
summary: Addressed how to measure revenue from barter transactions involving advertising services, permitting reference to the fair value of services provided rather than received. Superseded in 2018.

related.title: Revenue from Contracts with Customers
related.relationship: The standard that superseded SIC-31 in 2018 by replacing IAS 18 and absorbing barter advertising guidance into its general non-cash consideration measurement framework

related.title: Revenue
related.relationship: The parent standard under which SIC-31 was originally issued, addressing revenue recognition principles
